capabilities: Track income and expense records per note-based account
Manage debts, credits and deposits with payment schedules
Import and export CSV, JSON and XML data with field mapping
Show statistics, charts and credit-burden analytics
Attach photo receipts and documents to records
extras: Data is stored as JSON under .obsidian/plugins/finance-manager/accounts/, not inside the notes; UI auto-detects RU/EN from Obsidian settings; roadmap lists future scheduled transactions and one-click schedule recalculation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in ledger, so tracking per-account income, expenses, debts, loans and deposits requires external tools.
summary: Note-based finance tracker that turns each Obsidian note into an account with income/expense records, debts, credits, deposits and analytics.
